status: evidence and maturity matrix for concrete revelations
purpose: Separate established external mechanisms from project syntheses and open hypotheses so the project can grow richer without blurring evidence classes.

levels.label: Established mechanism
levels.rule: Well-supported external concept or empirical finding with its own literature.

levels.label: Strong structural synthesis
levels.rule: Project operator maps cleanly onto an external mechanism and yields new tests, but the mapping itself is interpretive.

levels.label: Discovery candidate
levels.rule: A non-obvious bridge suggests a new relation or application that still requires case-specific testing.

levels.label: Speculative analogy
levels.rule: Interesting resemblance without enough mechanism or evidence; keep out of prominent canon until strengthened.

revelations.why: Nearly decomposable systems are established; applying them to House/Rooms is synthesis; claiming improved project outcomes requires measurement.
Autonomy/competence/relatedness and capability are established frameworks; Garden as capability amplifier is synthesis; institution-specific scoring must be tested.
Undesirable resilient regimes/traps are established; Swamp crosswalk is synthesis.
Adaptation/transformation distinctions are established; project restore/adapt/transform fork is synthesis.
Adaptive cycle is established as heuristic; Spiral relation is structural comparison, not identity.
Missing-data mechanisms are established; Shadow-as-missingness audit is a strong project synthesis.
Metric gaming/Goodhart effects have evidence; applying this to Fruit evaluation is synthesis.
Brokerage/structural holes are established network concepts; Door-as-brokerage is synthesis.
Polycentric governance is established; Local Center crosswalk is synthesis.
March's exploration/exploitation model is established; Research Lab/Canon application is synthesis.
Organizational decoupling/mission drift are established research areas; triune diagnostic is a project hypothesis to validate longitudinally.
Path dependence/increasing returns are established; Root taxonomy is synthesis.
Cultural transmission feedback is established; project graph implementation remains synthesis.
Network robustness/modularity are established; House graph design conclusions require testing.
LBD/UPK is established; using House as an LBD engine is an implementation hypothesis.
Meaning-in-life, SDT and capability research are established; continuous-alignment purpose model is synthesis.

promotion_rule: Only E1 evidence and E2 synthesis should appear as explanatory claims without special warning. E3 should be labeled discovery candidate/hypothesis and paired with a next test. E4 belongs in Research Lab.
